saintapediasuggest: Name of the extension, shown in Special:Version.
saintapediasuggest-button-label: Label of the floating button readers click to open the suggestion form.
saintapediasuggest-hide: {{Identical|Hide}} Tooltip on the control that dismisses the floating button for this browser tab.
saintapediasuggest-panel-title: Heading of the reader suggestion panel.
saintapediasuggest-panel-subtitle: Explanatory text under the panel heading.
saintapediasuggest-field-label: Label of the dropdown listing this page's suggestable Cargo fields.
saintapediasuggest-field-placeholder: Placeholder option shown before the reader picks a field.
saintapediasuggest-current-label: Label before the value currently stored in Cargo. Used in both the reader panel and the dashboard.
saintapediasuggest-current-empty: Shown in place of the current value when the stored field is empty.
saintapediasuggest-row-ordinal:
Fallback name for one row of a multi-row Cargo table, used when every candidate label field is empty. Parameters:
* $1 - 1-based position of the row
saintapediasuggest-row-id-tooltip:
Tooltip on the row label in the dashboard, giving Cargo's internal row id. Parameters:
* $1 - the Cargo _ID value
saintapediasuggest-error-norow: Shown when the submitted Cargo row id does not belong to this page and table — usually because the page was edited after the reader opened the form.
saintapediasuggest-suggested-label: Label before the value the reader proposes.
saintapediasuggest-comment-label: Label of the optional free-text comment field.
saintapediasuggest-comment-placeholder: Placeholder in the optional comment field.
saintapediasuggest-email-label: Label of the optional contact email field in the reader panel.
saintapediasuggest-email-placeholder: Placeholder in the optional contact email field.
saintapediasuggest-submit: Label of the button that submits the suggestion.
saintapediasuggest-success-title: Heading shown after a suggestion is accepted.
saintapediasuggest-success-body: Body text shown after a suggestion is accepted.
saintapediasuggest-error-generic: Shown when the submit fails for an unclassified reason.
saintapediasuggest-error-ratelimit: Shown when the per-IP daily limit is reached.
saintapediasuggest-error-nofield: Shown when the chosen table/field is not allow-listed, or the page has no row in that Cargo table.
saintapediasuggest-error-novalue: Shown when the suggested value is empty.
saintapediasuggest-error-unchanged: Shown when the suggested value equals the stored value.
saintapediasuggest-error-namespace: Shown when the page's namespace is not in $wgSaintapediaSuggestNamespaces.
saintapediasuggest-error-disabled: Shown when the reader widget is switched off wiki-wide.
saintapediasuggest-error-captcha: Shown when the captcha answer was wrong.
saintapediasuggest-error-captcha-unavail: Shown when a captcha is required but ConfirmEdit/hCaptcha is not configured.
saintapediasuggest-toolbox: Toolbox link to the suggestion dashboard for the current page.
saintapediasuggest-toolbox-count:
Toolbox link when new suggestions exist. Parameters:
* $1 - number of new suggestions
saintapediasuggest-toolbox-open:
Toolbox link when open (new or reviewed) suggestions exist. Parameters:
* $1 - number of open suggestions
saintapediasuggest-dashboard-intro: Introductory paragraph at the top of the dashboard, stressing that triage does not change data.
saintapediasuggest-page-title:
Page title of the per-article view. Parameters:
* $1 - prefixed page title
saintapediasuggest-back-to-dashboard: Link from the per-article view back to the full dashboard.
saintapediasuggest-none: Shown when no suggestions match the active filters.
saintapediasuggest-unknown-page:
Shown when a page ID in the URL does not exist. Parameters:
* $1 - the page ID
saintapediasuggest-deleted-page: Shown in place of a page link when the page has been deleted.
saintapediasuggest-status-new: Status chip: not yet looked at. {{Identical|New}}
saintapediasuggest-status-reviewed: Status chip: seen by a reviewer, no action yet.
saintapediasuggest-status-actioned: Status chip: a human applied the change elsewhere.
saintapediasuggest-action-reviewed: Button on one suggestion, sets status to reviewed.
saintapediasuggest-action-actioned: Button on one suggestion, sets status to actioned.
saintapediasuggest-action-dismissed: Button on one suggestion, sets status to dismissed. {{Identical|Dismiss}}
saintapediasuggest-bulk-reviewed: Bulk button, sets every checked suggestion to reviewed.
saintapediasuggest-bulk-actioned: Bulk button, sets every checked suggestion to actioned.
saintapediasuggest-bulk-dismissed: Bulk button, dismisses every checked suggestion.
saintapediasuggest-bulk-selectall: Label of the checkbox that selects every suggestion on the page.
saintapediasuggest-bulk-confirm:
JavaScript confirmation before applying a bulk status change. Parameters:
* $1 - number of selected suggestions
saintapediasuggest-worknote-label: Label before a reviewer's private note on the dashboard.
saintapediasuggest-worknote-placeholder: Placeholder in the reviewer note input.
saintapediasuggest-email-label-dashboard: Label before the submitter's contact email on the dashboard. Only shown to users with saintapediasuggest-viewemail.
saintapediasuggest-filter-search: Label of the dashboard free-text search box. {{Identical|Search}}
saintapediasuggest-filter-search-placeho: Placeholder in the dashboard search box.
saintapediasuggest-filter-target: Label of the dropdown filtering by Cargo table and field. {{Identical|Field}}
saintapediasuggest-filter-target-all: Option in the field filter meaning no field restriction.
saintapediasuggest-filter-apply: Button that applies the dashboard filters. {{Identical|Apply}}
saintapediasuggest-sort-newest: Sort option: most recent suggestions first.
saintapediasuggest-export: Link that downloads the current filtered result set as JSON.
saintapediasuggest-pager-prev: Pagination link to the previous (newer) page of results.
saintapediasuggest-pager-next: Pagination link to the next (older) page of results.
saintapediasuggest-pager-summary:
Pagination summary. Parameters:
* $1 - first row number shown
* $2 - last row number shown
* $3 - total matching rows
saintapediasuggest-detail-link: Link from a suggestion in the list to its full detail view.
saintapediasuggest-detail-title:
Page title of the detail view. Parameters:
* $1 - suggestion ID
* $2 - Cargo target as Table.Field
saintapediasuggest-unknown-suggestion:
Shown when a suggestion ID in the URL does not exist. Parameters:
* $1 - the suggestion ID
saintapediasuggest-page-suggestions-link: Link from the detail view to the per-article list.
saintapediasuggest-duplicate-badge:
Badge showing how many additional readers reported the same value. Parameters:
* $1 - number of folded duplicates
saintapediasuggest-duplicates-heading:
Heading above the list of folded duplicate submissions. Parameters:
* $1 - number of duplicates
saintapediasuggest-audit-heading: Heading above the audit-log table on the detail view.
saintapediasuggest-audit-empty: Shown when a suggestion has never had its status changed.
saintapediasuggest-audit-when: Column header: timestamp of a status change. {{Identical|When}}
saintapediasuggest-audit-who: Column header: user who made a status change. {{Identical|Who}}
saintapediasuggest-audit-note: Column header: the reviewer note recorded with a status change. {{Identical|Note}}
saintapediasuggest-audit-unknown-user: Shown in the audit log when the acting user cannot be resolved.
saintapediasuggest-lookup-label: Label of the box for jumping to one article's suggestions by title.
saintapediasuggest-lookup-placeholder: Placeholder in the page-title lookup box.
saintapediasuggest-lookup-go: Button that performs the page-title lookup. {{Identical|Go}}
saintapediasuggest-lookup-notfound:
Shown when the looked-up page title does not exist. Parameters:
* $1 - the title the user typed
saintapediasuggest-flash-updated: Confirmation after one suggestion's status changed.
saintapediasuggest-flash-notfound: Shown when the targeted suggestion no longer exists.
saintapediasuggest-flash-token: Shown when the CSRF token did not match.
saintapediasuggest-flash-badstatus: Shown when the requested status is not one of reviewed/actioned/dismissed.
saintapediasuggest-flash-noselection: Shown when a bulk action was submitted with nothing checked.
saintapediasuggest-flash-bulk:
Confirmation after a bulk status change. Parameters:
* $1 - number of suggestions updated
echo-category-title-saintapediasuggest: Title of the Echo notification category in user preferences.
echo-pref-tooltip-saintapediasuggest: Tooltip for the Echo notification preference.
notification-header-saintapediasuggest-n:
Echo notification header. Parameters:
* $1 - prefixed title of the page
notification-body-saintapediasuggest-new:
Echo notification body. Parameters:
* $1 - Cargo target as Table.Field
* $2 - the suggested value, truncated to 200 characters

Echo notification body when no suggested value is available. Parameters:
* $1 - Cargo target as Table.Field
notification-link-saintapediasuggest-new: Label of the Echo notification link to the dashboard.
saintapediasuggest-freshness-applied: Badge on a suggestion whose proposed value is what Cargo now holds — the change appears to have been made already.
saintapediasuggest-freshness-changed: Badge on a suggestion whose field has since changed to something that is neither what the reader saw nor what they proposed.
saintapediasuggest-freshness-unapplied: Badge on a suggestion marked actioned whose field still holds the value the reader originally reported — the edit may never have been made.
saintapediasuggest-freshness-unapplied-t: Tooltip for the 'Actioned, but unchanged' badge.
